Ranvir Alias Rinku And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
on 22 May, 2023

Author: Vivek Kumar Birla
Bench: Vivek Kumar Birla
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:112022-Db
Court No. - 45
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 7077 of 2023
Petitioner :- Ranvir Alias Rinku And 2 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Rakesh Kumar Singh,Pradeep Kumar
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
1.

Heard Shri Rakesh Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners and Shri Sushil Kumar
Jaiswal, learned State Law Officer appearing on behalf of the State.

2.  This writ petition has been filed for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 21.04.2023 in Case Crime No. 205 of 2023, under Sections 498-A, 376, 377, 504 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Shyohara, District Bijnor and a direction to the respondent authorities not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of the impugned first information report.

Ranvir Alias Rinku And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186531936/
1 3.

entities.text: Ranvir Alias Rinku And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners is that the entire family has been roped in on general allegations and no offence has been made out.

4. Per contra, learned State Law Officer on instructions pointed out that the victim has supported the prosecution vdrsion in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and a cognizable offence is made out.
5. Perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie reveals commission of cognizable offence.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
